article.headline: Tired of spending hours washing your car?
article.subheadline: What about scratches, fading, and oxidation? Read this article before you do anything else.

intro.p1: Let's face it: we've all been there. Over time, your car's paint starts to fade, your trim looks dull, and those annoying scratches and oxidation spots won't go away.
intro.p2: You could ignore it, but that fading shine and dull appearance is slowly driving your car's value down. Worse, your vehicle is vulnerable to further damage from UV rays, rust, and dirt buildup.
intro.p3: And the prices for cleaning, waxing, scratch removal and other damage at car dealerships aren't just high - they're mind-blowing.

problemSection.statHeadline: Over $10,000 Spent on Paint Fade, Scratches & Oxidation
problemSection.p1: According to a recent study by the National Motorists Association, the average motorist spends between $10,000 and $15,000 over the life of a car just to clean, wax and remove scratches, rust and their effects.
problemSection.p2: Hundreds and thousands of dollars and hours of waiting just to maintain your vehicle properly.
problemSection.p3: After all, it's not just about aesthetic damage.
problemSection.p4: Scuffs, paint fading, scratches, oxidation and rust over time not only continue to worsen the appearance of the car, but also destroy it from the inside, increasing the potential cost of repair, sometimes tens and even hundreds of times.

solutionSection.heading: Just One Solution That Can Save Your Car
solutionSection.p1: Why spend hours washing and polishing your car all the time? Spend hundreds or even thousands of dollars out of your budget on yet another protective coating or repair?
solutionSection.p2: You can get every inch of every coating on your car uniquely clean and shiny with just a few simple steps.
solutionSection.p3: These simple steps will not only make your car shine, but will also eliminate scratches, paint fading and oxidation marks on your headlights, and protect your car's coating from future damage.
solutionSection.p4: A few steps that will transform your car care experience from "before" to "after."

rustScratchesSection.heading: Rust & Scratches? Not A Problem Anymore.
rustScratchesSection.p1: TurboShine™ not only cleans, polishes and protects your car, but also tackles the toughest enemies of the motorist - scratches and rust.
rustScratchesSection.p2: The microscopic particles that form the basis of the advanced micro-abrasive formula gently polish paint and erase the edges of scratches, while the product's denser particles penetrate deep imperfections to fill them and create a smooth and even surface.
rustScratchesSection.p3: Due to its deep penetration into pores and microscopic crevices, the product initiates a chemical reaction that destroys iron oxide (rust), facilitating its removal and preventing its reappearance.
